exact_statement: For every fixed integer d >= 3, every N-point subset of R^d determines N^(2/d-o(1)) distinct distances as N tends to infinity.
scope_notes: Cold strategy restart with warm inheritance of counterexamples, obstruction certificates, and exact algebraic lemmas.
Promotion requires a rigorous dimension-three distance exponent strictly greater than 3/5, with every Euclidean realization and stability bridge proved.
Reuse factorial-energy identities, the aperiodic-mask torsion result, and gcd(P(x^r),P(x^s))=1 for P=1+x+x^3+x^5+x^6 as kill-test evidence.
Signed-switch and single-row cyclotomic constructions have no priority unless they supply both power-large conditioning and a second-row Euclidean consequence.
